title: Cookbook:Marinated Cucumbers and Onions
wikitext:
{{Recipe summary
| Category = Vegetable recipes
| Difficulty = 1
}}

{{recipe}}

This is a nice, light, cooling [[Cookbook:Salad|salad]] or side dish to have during the hot summer months. 
== Ingredients ==
* 2 [[cookbook:Cucumber|cucumbers]]
* 1 white [[cookbook:Onion|onion]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]]s (480 [[Cookbook:mL|ml]]) distilled white [[cookbook:Vinegar|vinegar]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]]s (10 ml) [[cookbook:Vegetable Oil|vegetable oil]]
* 1 teaspoon (5 ml) [[cookbook:sugar|sugar]]
* 1 teaspoon (5 ml) [[cookbook:salt|salt]]

== Procedure ==

# Mix vinegar, oil, salt and sugar for the marinade.
# Trim the ends from the cucumbers, peel them, and [[Cookbook:Slicing|slice]] them.
# Peel the onion and slice it as thinly as possible.
# Pour the marinade over the cucumbers and onions and mix well.
# Let it sit in a cool place or refrigerator for at least two hours, stirring occasionally.
# Serve in a bowl, marinade and all, using salad tongs or a slotted spoon to dish out servings.

==Notes, tips, and variations==
* Any light salad oil may be used. Avoid [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|olive oil]], as it congeals when refrigerated.
* The cucumber to onion ratio should be from 2:1 to 2.5:1.
* There should be just a hint of oil in the marinade and just enough sugar to take the edge off of the vinegar's tartness.
* For crisper pickles add a spoonful of oregano.
